claim: Across four 7-8B instruct code models and HumanEval+/MBPP+, no uncertainty metric exceeds AUC 0.70 for pass/fail discrimination.
stance_target: token-level uncertainty is a weak proxy for execution correctness in code LLMs
scope_conditions: four 7-8B instruct models; HumanEval+ and MBPP+; BigCodeBench excluded from Sec 4
quoted_support: For generation-stage uncertainty, the best AUC in each model-benchmark pairs ranges from 0.598 to 0.696. No metric exceeds 0.70, and several remain close to random ranking.

breadth.confidence_families: token confidence/entropy and 17 generation-stage plus 6 prefill-stage uncertainty scores (Sec 4, Tables 2-3); Platt/isotonic post-hoc calibration (Sec 6.1); prompted abstention 'I don't know' (Sec 6.3); hidden-state effective rank (Sec 7). No verbalized numeric confidence and no trained probe
breadth.base_vs_instruct: yes, only OpenCoder and DeepSeek-Coder base vs instruct on MBPP+ (Sec 5.5, Fig 4, paired bootstrap on delta-AUC)
breadth.post_training_stages: base vs instruction-tuned only (Sec 5.5); no RLHF/RL stage comparison
breadth.reasoning_models: not present (searched: reasoning, thinking, chain-of-thought; all four models non-reasoning)
breadth.elicitation_formats: token-probability readouts; one prompted abstention format (answer only if more than 95% confident else 'I don't know') (Sec 6.3); no verbal-confidence format comparison
breadth.label_independence: labels from benchmark tests, independent of model confidence; construct-validity caveat in Sec 10
breadth.contamination_split: not present (searched: contaminat, release date, cutoff; Sec 10 threats do not mention contamination)
breadth.calibration_metrics: AUC (Table 3), Brier score and Brier Skill Score (Table 5), selective accuracy vs coverage (Fig 3); no ECE found in the searched lines
breadth.granularity: whole program and token level (Sec 5.1-5.2); no per-requirement or per-test
breadth.causal_intervention: not present for hidden states (Sec 7 is correlational effective-rank comparison); calibration and prompting are interventions on readout only

claim: Platt scaling and isotonic regression sharply reduce Brier score but give Brier Skill Score near zero, i.e. no skill beyond the benchmark pass rate.
stance_target: calibration metrics can look good without discrimination in code
scope_conditions: MBPP+ and BigCodeBench, 5-fold stratified CV (Sec 6.1, Table 5)
quoted_support: Post-hoc calibration substantially improves probability alignment, but calibrated scores provide little predictive skill beyond the benchmark pass rate.

stance_target: base vs instruct comparison for code confidence is partially occupied at token level

quoted_support: Confidence AUC changes from 0.5230 to 0.5094, with DeltaAUC = -0.0136 and a 95% confidence interval of [-0.0911, 0.0652].

claim: Prompted abstention does not reliably induce deferral in code LLMs even with an explicit IDK option.
stance_target: verbal/prompted readouts are weak in code
scope_conditions: qualitative across the four subject models (Sec 6.3, Fig 6)
quoted_support: Prompt-level abstention does not reliably induce deferral; models can still generate incorrect code even when an IDK option is provided.
